review:
Re-read the stable tree on `build/autonomous-v0.1` at `8737869`. `adaptive.py` is `06E101A7547345A49F8F743EDA8FAEAC48780AFE7ADD5D59E4018DDF46A296A8`. Metrics `755C0DDFAA362CF873E3B690051213419C4F4FD23F3779056DDAAC6AB131A79A`. Orchestrator `A69BEB87DCDF4C01048ABD72F80509099FFC9D045F4526C87885C8BC012493D6`. Storage `48FE8155280CD7E5CF6C304C87917AEC31A09DA6C9377CAA3B9F51AA93A10196`. Tests were not executed.

The new STOP return, job binding, cached re-verify, atomic incumbent commit, and decision recomputation are in the file. Strict quality-tie rejection and `promote_eligible: False` still hold. Approved checkpoint rollback cannot run: every adaptive spec sets `route`, and the rollback condition requires it to be absent.

## Blockers

**1. Request or token exhaustion sticks the schedule and then lies about why.** `barrier(route)` runs only after `claim`. On a local route it moves that job to `RETRY_READY` and returns no evidence ([orchestrator.py:198](D:/Repos/hive-ai/src/hive/orchestrator.py:198)). `claim` only takes `QUEUED` ([storage.py:83](D:/Repos/hive-ai/src/hive/storage.py:83)). `recover` does not select `RETRY_READY` ([storage.py:127](D:/Repos/hive-ai/src/hive/storage.py:127)). Adaptive never requeues it ([adaptive.py:57](D:/Repos/hive-ai/src/hive/adaptive.py:57)).

Counterexample: `max_requests=1`. The first local job finishes. The next `_phase_entry` enqueues, `run_one` parks that job `RETRY_READY`, and the first pause text is `model request budget exhausted`. The next `run_adaptive` finds no result on that job, claims nothing, and overwrites the reason with `no eligible work` ([orchestrator.py:187](D:/Repos/hive-ai/src/hive/orchestrator.py:187)). `fixed_tool` is never enqueued, even though a tool route would not spend the request budget. The same path is `generated-token reservation budget exhausted`.

[configs/adaptive.json](D:/Repos/hive-ai/configs/adaptive.json) does not hit this on one clean pass: 30 local calls, 3840 reserved tokens, 36 cycles, against caps 48, 6144, and 100. Wall, storage, cycle, and STOP stop before `claim`, so those resumes keep the real reason. Crash replay still counts another request and another 128 tokens ([orchestrator.py:206](D:/Repos/hive-ai/src/hive/orchestrator.py:206)). Eighteen extra local replays burn the request margin and then hit this wedge.

**2. A changed local digest aborts after the development calls, with no pause record.** New development rows are saved without a binding check ([adaptive.py:327](D:/Repos/hive-ai/src/hive/adaptive.py:327)). The check runs only in the later loop ([adaptive.py:342](D:/Repos/hive-ai/src/hive/adaptive.py:342), [adaptive.py:133](D:/Repos/hive-ai/src/hive/adaptive.py:133)).

Counterexample: first valid local evidence digest `sha-a` writes `adaptive_model_binding`. The next valid local evidence digest `sha-b` raises `ValueError`. That is not `_AdaptivePaused`, so the campaign stays `RUNNING` and `stop_reason` is unchanged. Resume takes the already-saved branch ([adaptive.py:336](D:/Repos/hive-ai/src/hive/adaptive.py:336)) and raises the same error. No candidate is assessed. Invalid rows skip the binding check entirely (`valid is True` is required), so a digest change on a failed call is ignored and the router is fit on the remaining valid rows.

## Not blockers

Hard kill during development leaves Executor’s `policy` and `learning_environment` in place ([orchestrator.py:254](D:/Repos/hive-ai/src/hive/orchestrator.py:254)). Restore runs only later in this process ([adaptive.py:354](D:/Repos/hive-ai/src/hive/adaptive.py:354), [adaptive.py:535](D:/Repos/hive-ai/src/hive/adaptive.py:535)). `os._exit` skips both. The next adaptive resume rebuilds the experimental router from evidence and restores the snapshot. A normal worker loop before that resume trains on the experimental counts. `current_checkpoint` is not written.

The pause report and that restore run after `worker_lock` is released ([adaptive.py:496](D:/Repos/hive-ai/src/hive/adaptive.py:496), [adaptive.py:531](D:/Repos/hive-ai/src/hive/adaptive.py:531)). A second `run_adaptive` can take the lock before those writes.

A crash after the wall update and before `inflight` is cleared charges `reserved_wall_s` again on recover ([orchestrator.py:273](D:/Repos/hive-ai/src/hive/orchestrator.py:273), [orchestrator.py:122](D:/Repos/hive-ai/src/hive/orchestrator.py:122)). The mission can stop early for wall time it already recorded.

fixed: Check route budget before claim; retain exact pause reason across restart.
Verify identity on every new development result, including invalid results with known digest; persist ERROR before exiting.
Hold worker lock through error/pause persistence and cleanup.
Adaptive jobs disable operational learning; experimental router reconstructs only from verified development evidence.
Record actual wall usage and clear inflight reservation atomically.
limits: Resource exhaustion may stop the preregistered schedule; do not fabricate a paired comparison from missing local evidence.
